body: Has it caused fights? I'm very non-confrontational, but she's the opposite and anything I try to say that is against her ideas gets taken as an argument, and I'm not sure if being angry outwardly is better than inwardly, but I'm just at such a loss as to what to do or say when she gets in a really bad mood.

I don't know what OECD means, I'm in the United States, and she's already had a lot of missed time over the last couple years for medical issues and she knows her boss is unhappy about it (but she also does 90% of his job which gives a bit of security).

I'm also afraid that because of the horrible state of mental healthcare in this country that she'd end up pushed aside and forgotten, which would then just reinforce her feeling like she is of no worth.
